Kept: the files gen/sources.cmake lists for the library (BCM, CRYPTO and SSL sources, headers and assembly for every
platform), every header or .inc they include, LICENSE, gen/sources.cmake and gen/README.md, unchanged. Left out:
tests, test data, fuzzers, tools, bench, decrepit, pki, rust, util, the upstream CMakeLists.txt and build files.
third_party/boringssl.cmake builds it (two static libraries); nothing here is edited by hand.

To move to a newer release: download its archive, check its sha256 against the release page, run the same copy
(the files gen/sources.cmake lists plus their includes) into an empty third_party/boringssl, and update this file.
